description: `for ((x = xs.at(i)) is given)` runs once per element: 4 + 5 + 6 = 15.
rationale: §50 amendment (S473 D10): "The ONLY assignment-as-expression the language keeps is an assignment wrapped in its own parentheses inside the condition head of a `for (…)` or `if (…)` / `else if (…)` … as a parenthesized operand of the condition — `for ((m = re.exec(str)) is given) { … }`" · §50.3.1: "Produce the assigned value as the result of the expression."
